answer_1.quote: Dialogue Response Generation in open domain is a challenging task with a wide range of application scenarios.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we use the same metrics as used in PLATO, except for knowledge-related metrics, since this paper does not focus on utilizing knowledge. So we will focus the following metrics: BLEU-1/2, which measures the relevance of generated text to the reference text by calculating the 1/2-gram overlapping between them. Distinct-1/2, which measures the diversity of a generated sentence by focusing on the number of distinct 1/2-gram of a sentence

answer_4.quote: To make it more convincing, we conduct a human evaluation. Specifically, we randomly select 100 dialogue contexts and generate responses the following methods: PLATO, DialogVED and DialogVED-Sampling. Following PLATO, annotators are asked to compare the response (win, tie or lose) quality from four aspects: fluency, coherence, informativeness and overall.
answer_4.guideline: annotators are asked to compare the response (win, tie or lose) quality from four aspects: fluency, coherence, informativeness and overall.
